planSteps.description: Navigate to /. Enter test-moderator-token-0123456789 in the Mod token password input and click Unlock.
The Connection heading and Twitch & AI settings heading are visible, and connection status says not connected.
The LLM base URL input, AI model input and AI API key password input are visible. AI model status says not configured.
Navigate to /. Enter invalid-token into Mod token and click Unlock.
The error says Token rejected. The Mod access heading remains visible and Connection heading is hidden.
Navigate directly to /overlay-view.
A visible REPLAY badge is present. The overlay shows its waiting for approved lore empty state and connection status becomes connected. No boss HP numbers or sample quotes appear.
Navigate to /test-fixture and click Reset test data. Unlock with Mod token test-moderator-token-0123456789. Click Queue.
Pending (3), Approved (0), and Rejected (0) buttons are visible, with three pending cards and evidence IDs fixture-message-1 and fixture-message-2.

Navigate to /test-fixture, click Reset test data. Unlock with Mod token test-moderator-token-0123456789. Click Queue. Click the first Edit button, replace Edit lore text with Browser-approved community moment, and click Save & approve.
Click Approved (1).
Browser-approved community moment appears in the approved queue, and Pending (2) is visible.
Navigate to /test-fixture and click Reset test data. Unlock using Mod token test-moderator-token-0123456789. Click Queue then the first Reject button.
Click Rejected (1).
One rejected lore card appears, Pending (2) is visible, and the rejected card offers no Approve button.

Navigate to /test-fixture and click Reset test data. Unlock using Mod token test-moderator-token-0123456789. Click Queue then the first Approve button. Click Setup. Enter 120 into Boss max HP and click Spawn boss.
The Boss panel shows phase fight, the approved lore text as boss name, and exactly 120 / 120 HP.
Navigate to /test-fixture and click Reset test data. Unlock using Mod token test-moderator-token-0123456789. On Setup click Purge session content…
Confirm purge and Keep buttons appear before deletion.
Click Confirm purge, then click Queue.
Pending (0), Approved (0), and Rejected (0) are all visible and no lore cards remain.
